input:
Today: 2026-11-22 (Sunday). Household currency: USD. Speaker: Dara (me). Partner: Shilan.
People: Alex (friend), Karwan (Dara's brother), Rebin (colleague), Aram (Dara's uncle), Mom (Dara's mother).
Already parsed: amount IQD 10000, date today.
Message: """Spent ten thousand dinars on lunch with the kids"""

intent.instructions: What kind of money event does the message describe?

criteria.expense: Money spent on goods, services or bills.
criteria.income: Money received and kept: salary, freelance pay, a gift received, a refund, a sale.
criteria.transfer: Money moved between the household's own or joint accounts, including cash withdrawals and currency exchange.
criteria.savings_move: Money put into or taken out of a savings goal.
criteria.loan_given: Money lent to someone who is expected to pay it back.
criteria.loan_taken: Money borrowed from someone or a bank, to be paid back.
criteria.repayment_received: Someone paying back money they owed us.
criteria.repayment_made: Us paying back money we borrowed, or paying an instalment on a loan or debt.
criteria.adjustment: Correcting an account balance or setting an opening balance.
criteria.question: A question about past spending, income, balances, budgets or entries.
criteria.command: A request to edit, delete or undo an entry, set a budget, create a goal or change a setting.
criteria.other: Greeting, chit-chat, unclear, or not about household money.

category.instructions: Which category fits this spending or income best?

criteria.groceries: Spending: Groceries (Food). Examples: supermarket, market, fruit, vegetables, meat, food shopping.
criteria.dining: Spending: Dining out (Food). Examples: restaurants, lunch or dinner out, takeaway, delivery, cafes.
criteria.bakery_tea: Spending: Bakery and tea (Food). Examples: bread, samoon, bakery, tea, coffee, sweets.
criteria.rent: Spending: Rent (Home). Examples: house or flat rent.
criteria.electricity_generator: Spending: Electricity and generator (Home). Examples: electricity bill, neighbourhood generator fee (ampere), fuel for a home generator.
criteria.water: Spending: Water (Home). Examples: water bill, drinking water delivery.
criteria.internet_phone: Spending: Internet and phone (Home). Examples: internet, mobile credit, phone bill.
criteria.household_goods: Spending: Household goods (Home). Examples: furniture, appliances, kitchen items, cleaning supplies.
criteria.repairs: Spending: Repairs (Home). Examples: plumber, electrician, home repairs.
criteria.fuel: Spending: Fuel (Transport). Examples: petrol, benzine, diesel for the car.
criteria.taxi: Spending: Taxi (Transport). Examples: taxi, ride hailing (Careem, Uber).
criteria.car_maintenance: Spending: Car maintenance (Transport). Examples: mechanic, car repair, tyres, oil change, car wash.
criteria.public_transport: Spending: Public transport (Transport). Examples: bus, minibus, train.
criteria.kids_school: Spending: Kids and school (Family). Examples: school fees, books, school supplies, kindergarten, toys.
criteria.health: Spending: Health (Family). Examples: doctor, pharmacy, medicine, hospital, dentist.
criteria.personal_care: Spending: Personal care (Family). Examples: barber, salon, cosmetics, toiletries.
criteria.gifts: Spending: Gifts (Social). Examples: presents bought for others.
criteria.family_support: Spending: Family support (Social). Examples: money given to support parents or relatives.
criteria.charity: Spending: Charity and zakat (Social). Examples: donations, zakat, mosque, charity.
criteria.occasions: Spending: Weddings and occasions (Social). Examples: weddings, funerals, Eid, parties, celebrations.
criteria.entertainment: Spending: Entertainment (Leisure). Examples: cinema, games, outings, hobbies.
criteria.travel: Spending: Travel (Leisure). Examples: flights, hotels, trips.
criteria.subscriptions: Spending: Subscriptions (Leisure). Examples: streaming, apps, memberships (Netflix, Spotify, gym).
criteria.fees: Spending: Fees (Finance). Examples: bank fees, transfer fees, card fees.
criteria.taxes: Spending: Taxes (Finance). Examples: taxes, government fees.
criteria.other_expense: Spending: Other spending. Examples: spending that fits no other category.
criteria.salary: Income: Salary (Earned). Examples: monthly salary, wages, bonus.
criteria.freelance: Income: Freelance (Earned). Examples: freelance or side work paid per job.
criteria.business: Income: Business (Earned). Examples: business or shop income.
criteria.gift_received: Income: Gifts received (Received). Examples: money given to us as a gift, Eid money.
criteria.refund: Income: Refunds (Received). Examples: refunds, returned purchases, cashback.
criteria.sale: Income: Sales (Received). Examples: selling our own things.
criteria.rental_income: Income: Rental income (Received). Examples: rent received from a tenant.
criteria.other_income: Income: Other income. Examples: income that fits no other category.

account.instructions: Which account was the money paid from or received into?

criteria.m2Rt6YwN8qZ3vB7xL4cC: Checking account, USD, mine (Dara's); bank account where salary arrives
criteria.j5Fh1KsD9aG4wE6rT8dD: Joint Visa card, USD, joint (shared by Dara and Shilan)
criteria.s4Gt8WrE2yU6iO1pA3fF: Savings account, USD, joint (shared by Dara and Shilan); holds the savings goals (vacation, car)
criteria.f1Nb5VcX7zL3kJ9hG2gG: FIB mobile wallet, IQD, mine (Dara's); First Iraqi Bank app
criteria.unspecified: The message does not say which account.

who.instructions: Whose spending or income is this?

criteria.joint: Both of them, for the shared household.

multi_entry.instructions: Does the message describe more than one separate money event?

criteria.true_description: Two or more separate payments, incomes or transfers are described.
criteria.false_description: Exactly one money event, or none (a question or a command).

needs_followup.instructions: Is information that is essential to record this event missing or ambiguous?

criteria.true_description: The amount is missing, or it is unclear whether money was spent, received, lent or borrowed, or what it was for.
criteria.false_description: The amount and the kind of event are clear; the account may be left to the default.

is_recurring.instructions: Is this a payment or income that normally repeats every month or week?

criteria.true_description: A regular bill, subscription, rent, instalment or salary.
criteria.false_description: A one-off or occasional purchase or event.
